Package index

Typicality tests

Exact combinatorial inference tests for the typicality of a mean point in a geometric (GDA) cloud (Le Roux, Bienaise & Durand 2019, chapters 3–4).

typicality_comb()
Combinatorial typicality test for a mean point
typicality_byvar()
Combinatorial typicality test for every category of a variable
typicality_geom()
Geometric typicality test for a mean point

Homogeneity test

Exact combinatorial test of the homogeneity of two groups in a geometric (GDA) cloud (Le Roux, Bienaise & Durand 2019, chapter 5).

homogeneity()
Combinatorial homogeneity test

Compatibility with GDA packages

Extract principal coordinates from the result objects of the common GDA packages, so the tests work whatever the upstream tool.

get_coord()
Extract principal coordinates from a GDA result

Methods

Print and plot methods for the test results.

print(<gdainference_test>) summary(<gdainference_test>)
Print a combinatorial inference test
print(<typicality_byvar>)
Print a by-category typicality table
print(<typicality_geom>)
Print a geometric typicality test
print(<homogeneity>)
Print a combinatorial homogeneity test
plot(<typicality_comb>)
Plot a combinatorial typicality test
plot(<typicality_geom>)
Plot a geometric typicality test
plot(<homogeneity>)
Plot a combinatorial homogeneity test

Data sets

Didactic data from Le Roux, Bienaise & Durand (2019).
